regions.cleaned_text: Born Blind Double Cataract case in 5000 to hope says Specialist. Robert LeBeault 5 from Lake Lindin, Mich .; about to be brought to Ann Arbor for Specialist examination - after others dis- couraging decisions - is enrolled To-day for 2 years, mother deciding to wait a week before going to said Specialist. Oct. 18 Same Robert reported as seeing perfectly - both cataracts removed perfectly. Deo Gr. Dec. 6 Boy's aunt reports To-day that boys sight is perfect - going to school regularly. 9 July 2 yrs later enrolled perpetually - beautiful eyes. August 17, 1934 called on way home from Chicago; now 13 OK
